notes: Calendar: an Events Calendar (eventscalendar.co / Inffuse) widget on arklac.org/calendar, read through its public JSON feed (266 entries, Jun 2025 to Dec 2026), plus 23 Wix Events pages. A very full calendar: area ministers' meetings, pastors' Zoom check-ups, board meetings, offerings and holidays all appear, so it shows the real rhythm of the conference.

Dropped as non-events: 50 'Offering:' Sabbath markers (the calendar doubles as the offering schedule), 21 office closures/holidays/observances (incl. Christmas party, Boss's Day, Administrative Assistant Day, DST, School Begins, camp-meeting pitch). Weekly Monday 'Prayer Zoom' (12 calendar entries plus 4 event pages) is listed once with a count.

Recurring meetings listed once with a count: area ministers' meetings (4 areas), pastors' monthly Zoom check-up, pastoral development meetings, executive committee, board of education/OAA board, elders' certification, union executive committee and presidents' council.

Evangelism is visible on the calendar, not just in policy: Forecasting Hope series (Sep 27-Oct 11, 2025), Lay Evangelism Bootcamp, the 'United Through Discipleship' lay-training series at six sites, Bible Worker certification (online April, field school Oct 24-31, 2026), a Spanish 'Caravana de la Compasion' (May 2026), two English 'Compassion Caravan' weeks (Oct 2026), and an evangelism mission trip to Brazil.

Strong bilingual track: separate Spanish camp meetings (South Louisiana and NW Arkansas), Spanish theological symposium, Spanish lay retreat, Spanish women's week of prayer, Spanish family camp and FESJA youth congress.
Camp meeting is regional, not one central event: South Louisiana (Hammond, Apr 17-18), NW Arkansas (Gentry, Jun 2-6), plus two Spanish campestres.

Adventurer conference camporee Oct 9-11, 2026 is marked 'Cancelled' on the 2026-27 Adventurer calendar (not counted). Master Guide calendar gives Master Guide Day as Aug 8; the conference calendar has Aug 6 (calendar date used).
Where the conference calendar and the 2025-26 Pathfinder calendar disagree (South Louisiana honors day: Mar 1 vs Feb 15), the conference calendar date is used.

Southwestern Union Record stories (61 ArkLa stories since mid-Sep 2025) confirm several calendar items and add local-church and school events, kept with level 'church' or 'institution': several local evangelistic series (Pineville 'Hope Rising', Fort Smith 'Revelation of Love', Heber Springs, Nicholls State campus meetings), a children's evening program, health-expo training, an academy mission trip and a suicide-prevention weekend.
